solution:
The correct answer is __**a - iii, b - ii, c - i, d - iv**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **(a) Habeas corpus - (iii) To have a body of**

 
 
• Habeas corpus is a legal action that requires a person under arrest to be brought before a judge or into court, especially to secure the person's release unless lawful grounds are shown for their detention. In essence, it protects individuals from being unlawfully detained.
 
 
 
• **​(b) Mandamus - (ii) To command**
 
 
• Mandamus is a writ issued by a court to compel the performance of a specific act by a lower court or government official. It commands a person or entity to perform a certain action.
 
 
 
• **(c) Quo warranto - (i) Enquiring into the legality of claim**
 
 
• Quo warranto is a legal proceeding in which the court inquires into the legality of a claim to a public office or franchise. It challenges the authority of a person to hold a particular office or position.
 
 
 
• **(d) Certiorari - (iv) To be certified**
 
 
• Certiorari is a writ issued by a higher court to review a decision of a lower court. It essentially certifies or confirms the lower court's records for review.
